rules.absorbed_requires: reviewed absorption evidence naming the accepted upstream change and local adaptation ID
rules.public_link_rule: Use a public upstream URL only after submission; otherwise use not-submitted or not-applicable.
rules.embargo_rule: Embargoed coordination stays outside public manifests. Public records must not contain a live confidential disposition, vulnerability details, affected paths, reproducers, or private links.
rules.consensus_rule: Roots policy/default choices are not upstream consensus requirements; RDTS/BIP110 enforcement remains absent.

dispositions.rationale: The recorded txrequest wrapper was absorbed by Core 29.4; any independently reproducible bookkeeping correction follows the normal upstream route.
dispositions.roots_provenance: 29.4 manual-resolution proposal records Core absorption of src/txrequest.cpp.
dispositions.retirement_condition: Only a reviewed upstream acceptance and local absorbed evidence may retire the adaptation.

dispositions.rationale: Configured local relay/template policy is intentional Roots behavior and is not represented as an upstream consensus change.
dispositions.roots_provenance: 29.3 adaptation manifest and 29.4 policy-consensus manual outcomes.
dispositions.retirement_condition: Retire only after a reviewed Roots policy decision removes or replaces the feature.

dispositions.rationale: Roots presentation identity and defaults are intentional fork behavior, not a generic upstream correction.
dispositions.roots_provenance: Roots-origin unit in the 29.3 adaptation manifest.
dispositions.retirement_condition: Retire only if a reviewed Roots identity decision supersedes the default.

dispositions.rationale: A self-contained regression test with a Core-reproducible failure is upstreamable without carrying Roots policy intent.
dispositions.retirement_condition: Mark absorbed only after reviewed upstream acceptance and equivalent local coverage evidence.

dispositions.rationale: A platform-independent CMake/build correctness fix with an upstream reproducer has a generic route; Roots CI identity restrictions do not.
dispositions.roots_provenance: 29.3 build/CI adaptation unit; route applies only to separable generic fixes.
dispositions.retirement_condition: Mark absorbed only after reviewed upstream acceptance and replay evidence removes the generic delta.
